nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and used in the onlyOwner guard.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership during two-step ownership handover.
Mapping of token holder balances mutated by transfer and transferFrom via safeAdd/safeSub.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
Fixed total token supply (690000000000000000) minted to the deployer-specified address in the constructor.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner; gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
Completes the ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.
Public token transfer moving balances from msg.sender to the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Public allowance setter writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no validation or zero-first check.
Public delegated transfer debiting balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and crediting balances[to].
Sets allowance then invokes the spender contract's receiveApproval callback, enabling external code execution mid-transaction.
Owner-only rescue function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by this contract.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], the burned-token adjusted circulating supply.
Returns the token balance of the supplied tokenOwner address.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender over a tokenOwner's balance.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain Ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as the authorization principal for transfers, approvals and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) invoking arbitrary user-supplied code from approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a user-supplied token contract from transferAnyERC20Token.
Address parameter of balanceOf identifying whose balance is read.
Spender address parameter of approve whose allowance is being set.
Amount parameter of approve recorded as the allowance value.
Recipient address parameter of transfer receiving the credited balance.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are debited.
Address parameter of transferOwnership staged as the pending newOwner.
Arbitrary token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token used as the external call target.
Opaque bytes payload parameter of approveAndCall forwarded verbatim into the receiveApproval callback.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the debited account in transfer(balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...)).
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and is forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
Owner-authorized transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable, changing the authorization principal.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for msg.sender and the spender.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the external call.
approveAndCall hands control to the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall (or approve/transferFrom) before the original frame completes.
transferAnyERC20Token calls into an attacker-influenced ERC20 contract at tokenAddress.
The external ERC20 transfer call can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token or other contract functions.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply to compute the returned supply value.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested tokenOwner.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
The spender parameter selects the allowance slot written by approve.
The tokens parameter is stored as the new allowance value in approve.
The to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
The from parameter supplies both the debited balance and allowance slot in transferFrom.
The _newOwner parameter is assigned to the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
The tokenAddress parameter is used as the target of the external ERC20 call in transferAnyERC20Token.
The data parameter is forwarded unchanged into the receiveApproval callback by approveAndCall.

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter used only as a mapping key inside balanceOf; fold it into the enclosing function node.
Spender address parameter consumed solely by approve to index the allowed mapping.
Token amount parameter stored directly into the allowance slot by approve.
Recipient parameter used only for the balance credit within transfer.
Source parameter used only to debit balances and allowance within transferFrom.
Pending owner parameter written only into newOwner by transferOwnership.
Token contract parameter used only as the external call target in transferAnyERC20Token.
Opaque bytes parameter forwarded only into the receiveApproval external call within approveAndCall.
